## get-user-info

Kind: Read.

Prints account data such as email, names, user ID, cash and billing status.

Secret-looking map keys, such as password, token and credential, print as
`<redacted>` at any depth.

Responses are limited to 8 MiB. The SDK suppresses response captures and rejects
reflected credentials, duplicate keys and conflicting envelopes.

No fields.

```sh
greennode portal get-user-info --query UserInfo
```
